title: kbingest map lets a repository's Directory.Build.rsp add MSBuild switches
goal: DotnetMapper's dotnet msbuild argument list carries -noAutoResponse, so a Directory.Build.rsp committed in the project folder or above it (read automatically by MSBuild, turned off only by -noAutoResponse per Microsoft Learn msbuild-response-files) cannot add -target, -restore or -logger to the evaluation; a test named kbingest_map_dotnet_no_auto_response with a planted .rsp asserts the exact argument list, and a planted removal of the switch fails it (sprint review ST-ptn4bkh3 finding F1)
